params.Bodytext:
• constant1.count — particles = count²: 300–1000 (1000 → 1 000 000 points; sim textures become 1000×1000, ~60 fps)
• noise1.period / amp — noise scale / strength: 0.3–3 / 0.2–1 (1 / 0.5). Monochrome = Off → x, y, z drift independently
• math_step.gain — noise step per frame: 0.0002–0.003 (0.001)
• threshold1.threshold — which points rotate: 0.3–0.7 (0.5)
• point_xform.ry — constant spin per frame, degrees: 0.1–2 (0.5); rx and rz stay 0. No expression on ry any more
• life_pos uP Value Z — life before respawn, seconds: 3–20 (8)
• key_reset — press key 1 to rebuild the points from scratch
Do not touch: fb_pos, fb_src, pos, end, start, pos_sim_pixel.

params.Bodytext:
• pointsprite1.alpha — point brightness: 0.25–0.35 (0.30)
• pointsprite1 blending — ON, Source * = sa, Destination * = omda (normal alpha). Additive (one / omda) clips 1e6 sprites to solid white — do not switch it
• pointsprite1.pointsize — NO effect in this build: the particle primitive always renders as fixed ~1 px points (left at 0.01 as a reference)
• geo_ps children — add_pt (1 point) → convert_pt (to particles); each point becomes one sprite. Keep their render/display flags as they are
• camera1.tz — camera distance: 4.0–6.0 (4.6; FOV 25°, sphere fills ~97% of frame height)
• math_shape.gain — sphere radius: 0.5–2 (1.0); math_shape.postoff (Post Add) — shape: −0.5–0.5 (0)
• geo_ps.numinstances — 1 000 000, follows the size of pos automatically
Do not touch: math_len (mono32float keeps the normalise exact), comp_div, end.

params.Bodytext:
• level_color.highr / highg / highb — colour: 0–1 (0.55 / 1.0 / 0.75 = mint)
• level_color.brightness1 — overall brightness: 1.0–1.5 (1.5; peaks reach 0.48, nothing clips)
• bloom1.bloomthreshold — peaks sit just under 0.5, so lower it to 0.3–0.4 to get a visible glow
• bloom1.bloomintensity — glow strength: 0.5–2 (1.0)
• bg1.colorr / colorg / colorb — background RGB 0–1 (0.02 / 0.02 / 0.035)
• out1 — final output 1920×1080, take the picture from here
Do not touch: over1 (bottom input is bg1), the name out1.
